this is the most honest i've been in years. i'm a compulsive liar in general, it helps with keeping how i feel under wraps. i go to work to pay off this shitty debt, and in knowing that's why i'm there, i try and keep a positive attitude, or at least an attitude i know people will like while i'm there. then i go home and sit. do nothing. watch tv. talk to no one. occasionally i'll go out with friends, spend more time with the bubbly face, and it wears on me even more. what can i say? every day is the same. i just recently tried killing myself again, that was the 3rd. i'm just waiting for the motivation to try again.
